hard_fail_if: fullscreen slide-card grammar is primary visual language
narration carries explanation while visuals merely illustrate it
static or near-static holds exceed 2.5 seconds without intentional comedic purpose
character is not physically acting/reacting/manipulating the world
chapter transitions are title cards instead of changes in action/location/problem
opening lacks a physical conflict, reversal, surprise, or high-curiosity visual in first 3 seconds
first 15 seconds lack clear stakes or viewer promise
sound design does not punctuate impacts, reveals, reversals, and jokes
ending does not pay off an opening object/conflict/callback
